from pathlib import Path

wb = load_workbook(input_path)

# Remove all characters except digits, decimal points, and commas in the allowed range only.
# Text cells remain text so commas and trailing decimal zeroes are preserved.
pattern = re.compile(r'[^0-9.,]')

for row in ws['A1:H1']:

        original_value = cell.value

            cell.value = original_value
        else:
            cell.value = cleaned

wb.save(output_path)

# Verification
check_wb = load_workbook(output_path, data_only=False)
check_ws = check_wb['Sheet1']
